rationale: The only implementation delta is that the fixed version additionally calls free_netdev(sitn->fb_tunnel_dev) after ipip6_dev_free() when device registration fails. The Logic section states only that registration failure triggers cleanup by freeing the allocated device and returning the error. This is an abstract description of the cleanup goal and does not specify the particular freeing sequence or assert the additional fixed-side call. All other stated initialization, fallback, allocation, registration, and error-handling behavior is shared by both versions.
